_source: PennDOT open data, ArcGIS MapServer layer opendata/interstatemilemarkers (surveyed interstate mile markers, 1432 statewide, whole miles only)
_projection: game x = (lon + 75.1924) * cos(40.0127 deg) * 111320 ; game z = (40.0127 - lat) * 110540  (the same LAT0/LON0 the bakes use)
_note: Only miles 340, 341 and 342 fall inside the baked corridor; they land within 0.9 m of the eastbound reference line and anchor HWY_MILEPOSTS in index.html. The layer carries no tenth-mile posts and no US 1, so tenths are interpolated (labelled APPROX in the HUD) and the Roosevelt Expressway shows no mileage.
